title: Ostomy Supply Program Convex Barrier Supply Period Aligned to Urology and Continence Supply Program Deliveries and the Authorization
content:
The supply days of an Ostomy Supply Program convex-barrier (A4407) refill replace the tier's standard supply days and follow the customer's other Larkfield deliveries and the authorization: a customer with an active continence program whose latest continence refill's supply ends at least 30 days and fewer than the tier's standard supply days from today, on a grant valid at least the standard supply days from today, gets the whole 30-day blocks to the end of that continence supply, so both lines come due together; where the grant's valid-through date is fewer than the standard supply days from today and at least 30 days away, the supply is the whole 30-day blocks to the valid-through date; otherwise the supply is the tier's standard supply days.

## Terms

- **Continence records** - the customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program holdings (whether one is active) and the latest continence refill shipment sent to the customer, with its ship date and supply days. That supply ends the continence refill's supply days after its ship date.
- **The grant** - the program's authorization grant for the convex barrier; its valid-through date is read in days from today.
- **Whole 30-day blocks** - the number of days divided by 30, rounded down, times 30.
- **Standard supply days per shipment** by tier:

| Tier | Standard supply days |
|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | 30 |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | 30 |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | 90 |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | 90 |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | 90 |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | 30 |

## Ladder

| Records | Supply days |
|---|---|
| Active continence program; its latest refill's supply ends at least 30 and fewer than the standard supply days from today; grant valid at least the standard supply days from today | Whole 30-day blocks to the end of that continence supply |
| Grant's valid-through date fewer than the standard supply days from today and at least 30 days away | Whole 30-day blocks to the valid-through date |
| Otherwise | The tier's standard supply days |

## Cases (hypothetical, standard supply 90 days)

- Active continence program whose supply ends 75 days from today; grant valid 200 days: 75 rounded down to whole 30-day blocks is 60 supply days.
- Continence supply ends 95 days from today: not fewer than 90, so the first row does not apply; grant valid 200 days: 90 supply days.
- No continence program; grant valid through 70 days from today: 60 supply days.
- Grant valid through 20 days from today: fewer than 30 days away, so neither row applies: 90 supply days.
- On a tier whose standard supply is 30 days, no supply both reaches 30 days and falls short of 30 days, so the supply is always 30 days.
